claims.meaning: Every admitted history eventually completes at some finite time
claims.formula: forall S in D, exists finite t with complete_R(S,t)

claims.meaning: For every finite bound a completed history can take longer
claims.formula: forall N, exists S in D with finite completion_time_R(S)>N

claims.meaning: One admitted infinite history never completes
claims.formula: exists S in D such that forall finite t, not complete_R(S,t)

claims.meaning: For each fixed parsing policy R the fully completed history has a unique decomposition
claims.formula: forall completed S in D, exists exactly one valid decomposition P under R

claims.meaning: Every admissible parsing policy gives the same decomposition
claims.formula: forall S and all permitted R1,R2, P_R1(S)=P_R2(S)

claims.meaning: Every partial prefix reveals its exact final terminal point without waiting
claims.formula: forall prefix p, same terminal classification across all admitted futures

claims.meaning: Live execution produces verified positive out-of-sample returns
claims.formula: positive net outcome under costs latency fills and held-out sample
